pages.text: The Gas Turbine burns $(l)Biogas$() or $(l)Methane$() into FE. It is small and cheap, and it is the first generator that runs without you shovelling fuel. Methane gives more than twice the power of Biogas.

$(li)It is a small multiblock: place a $(l:basics/cyber_frame)Cyber Frame$(/l) $(l)in front of it$() and one $(l)behind it$().$(br)$(li)$(l)Right-click$() the machine and mini drones fly out and project the frames where they go.$(br)$(li)Hold sneak to place a frame against the machine itself.
pages.title: Building it

pages.text: $(li)With both frames there it assembles: the duct and the nozzle slide out of the drum and the rotor blooms.$(br)$(li)It does not work until then. Breaking a frame folds it back and stops it; put the frame back and it opens again.

$(li)Feed it with $(l:cables/gas_pipe)Gas Pipes$(/l) or any other mod's fluid pipes.$(br)$(li)Pipes and conduits connect at the three mint sockets of the machine block: on either side or on top.$(br)$(li)It $(l)pushes power by itself$() into adjacent machines and $(l:cables/energy_conduit)Energy Conduits$(/l).
pages.title: Using it

pages.text: $(li)A conduit on one of its frames can also pull the power with its arm (see $(l:cables/energy_conduit)Energy Conduit$(/l)).$(br)$(li)The rotor turns as fast as it makes power, so methane spins it faster than biogas.$(br)$(li)The slits on its flanks show how much gas is left.

$(li)$(l)Biogas$(): 5 FE per mB, 100 FE/t$(br)$(li)$(l)Methane$(): 12 FE per mB, 240 FE/t$(br)$(li)$(l)Gas burned$(): 20 mB/t$(br)$(li)$(l)Gas tank$(): 16,000 mB$(br)$(li)$(l)Buffer$(): 50,000 FE$(br)$(li)$(l)Output$(): up to 400 FE/t per side$(br)$(l)Two$() $(l:generators/bio_digester)Bio-Digesters$(/l) keep it at full power on Biogas.
pages.title: Numbers

pages.text: $(li)It only burns gas when its energy buffer has room, so no gas is wasted.$(br)$(li)A turbine from an older world waits for its frames, with its gas kept. Move any pipe that sits where a frame goes.$(br)$(li)For more FE out of every mB, build a $(l:generators/steam_engine)Steam Engine$(/l).
